svg.text: Self-Hosted AI Agent Architecture: Zero-Trust Mesh Topology
Hardened VPS hosting, WireGuard P2P overlay, Technitium split-DNS, and sandboxed OpenClaw execution (2026)
• Port scanners see zero open ports
Accessible only by authenticated Tailscale peers
ZERO-TRUST SECURITY INVARIANTS FOR PRODUCTION AI AGENT HOSTING
Drop all incoming packets on eth0.
Admin and API traffic must travel exclusively
Disable root login and password auth.
Run OpenClaw as an unprivileged user
Avoid listening webhooks to keep the VPS
